<description>
fixes #33128

this picks up #33164

on a normal start (without `-reindex`), `CompleteChainstateInitialization()`
calls `LoadGenesisBlock()`, which writes the genesis block to `blk00000.dat`
unless the block index already contains it. if `blocks/index` was deleted,
then the index is empty, so genesis is _unconditionally_ written again
even though the file is still intact on disk and holds all the later blocks

that write eventually reaches `AllocateFileRange()`, which allocates
space from the start of the file. with `posix_fallocate()`, this only
reserves space. on platforms without it (e.g. OpenBSD, NetBSD), the
fallback writes zeroes over the requested range, replacing the blocks
that were already there

only after that, does the node notice that the chainstate no longer
matches the block index and fail with `"Error initializing block database"`,
asking for `-reindex`. by then, the blocks are already gone, so the reindex
finds the genesis only, reports success, and `getblockcount` returns `0`

---

this PR makes `LoadGenesisBlock()` read the genesis block back _from
disk first_ and only write it when it is not already there. if genesis
is already on disk, update the blockfile info with its position and
size so that the next block is written after it instead of overwriting it
</description>

<commits>
40216397d7 validation: avoid rewriting genesis block when already on disk

If the block index is missing while the block files still hold valid
data, the genesis block is written to disk again on startup. On
platforms without a real preallocation syscall, that rewrite can
overwrite the blocks that follow genesis (#33128)

Read the genesis block back first and only write it when it is not
already there. If genesis is already on disk, update the block file
info so that the next block is written after it rather than overwriting
existing data
</commits>

<files>
src/validation.cpp  +17/-4

(test/bench/ci lines: 0)
</files>

<patch>
diff --git a/src/validation.cpp b/src/validation.cpp
index 6bed39ba5f..ef140fa11f 100644
--- a/src/validation.cpp
+++ b/src/validation.cpp
@@ -5030,10 +5030,23 @@ bool ChainstateManager::LoadGenesisBlock()
     }
 
     try {
-        FlatFilePos blockPos{m_blockman.WriteBlock(genesis_block, 0)};
-        if (blockPos.IsNull()) {
-            LogError("Writing genesis block to disk failed");
-            return false;
+        // The block index can be missing while block file 0 still holds
+        // the genesis block. Reuse it rather than writing it again: a
+        // rewrite would allocate from the start of the file, which on
+        // platforms whose AllocateFileRange() fallback writes zeroes
+        // would overwrite the blocks that follow genesis. Record it in
+        // the blockfile info as WriteBlock() would, so the next block
+        // is not written over it.
+        CBlock existing_block;
+        FlatFilePos blockPos{0, node::STORAGE_HEADER_BYTES};
+        if (m_blockman.ReadBlock(existing_block, blockPos, genesis_block.GetHash())) {
+            m_blockman.UpdateBlockInfo(genesis_block, 0, blockPos);
+        } else {
+            blockPos = m_blockman.WriteBlock(genesis_block, 0);
+            if (blockPos.IsNull()) {
+                LogError("Writing genesis block to disk failed");
+                return false;
+            }
         }
         CBlockIndex* pindex{m_blockman.AddToBlockIndex(genesis_block, m_best_header)};
         ReceivedBlockTransactions(genesis_block, pindex, blockPos);

</patch>
(Diff from merge base to head, smallest files first.)
